decisions.reason: The materials management module was only launched in 2024 and is a low-cost modular extension of the core practice software, so its value is still uncertain and the option is cheap to keep open.

The KIM secure messaging service is tied to the mandatory telematics infrastructure, has its own page and is being actively updated (KIM 1.5), so it is a regulatory necessity rather than an uncertain option and is very unlikely to be dropped.
